Expected columns: App, string ID, item ID, values, values-xx (original), values-xx (corrected).
Reference-compatible workbookOne visible sheet with App, string ID, item ID, and the reference values* columns.
Full reverse conversionEvery run reads the workbook and rebuilds all translation XML files, even when no cell values changed.
Safe legacy conversionFor an existing consolidated workbook, add its source ZIP so non-translation files and the directory tree are preserved.
Controlled correctionsApply exact text replacements by language and optionally align translation capitalization with English before export.
Open-source browser utility. XLSX support is provided by SheetJS; archive handling by JSZip.
